purpose: Calibration panels for the v2 posterior (prior mean, prior covariance, heteroscedastic HF noise) on the heterogeneous responder population. Also used for the leave-one-root-out pre-flight of all selectors. NEVER used as method-confirmation evidence.
note_on_pilot_roots: 48000-48003 are the pilot roots; run_melting_v4.py --resume reuses their completed panels byte-for-byte.

preflight_gate_before_confirmation_freez.loro_long_kg_minus_uniform_mean: > 0 (12 roots, descriptive; CI need not exclude 0)
preflight_gate_before_confirmation_freez.posterior_calibration: root-held-out 95% predictive interval coverage of selection observations in [0.80, 1.00] for both adaptations
preflight_gate_before_confirmation_freez.on_gate_fail: STOP and report. Do not tune shrinkage/noise floors against LORO regret.
